title: TenantReactivatedPayload
description: Payload of TenantReactivated (LLD §7.5, RP-D13) as PRODUCED by this service — RP-10's paid branch, source=operator, reverting a billing-lapse or RP-14 operator suspension back to active. Billing's own TenantReactivated (source=billing) is a distinct message on the billing.events topic, consumed on billing-realm-q — not validated by this schema.
